definitions: A flat surface or device on which films, slides, or television pictures are projected or displayed.
A movable device, typically consisting of a frame with a gauze or net stretched across it, used for separating or concealing.
A large, usually flat, surface that forms part of a wall or is freestanding, used for displaying information or images publicly.
examples: The film was shown on a large screen.
She put up a screen to divide the room.
The airport departure screen showed the flight was delayed.
